What this demo can and cannot do

Responses select approved prewritten facts using fixed topic rules. This is not an AI conversation or a complete qualification assessment. Unmatched topics are redirected. It cannot browse, run tools, disclose private career documents or add unsupported credentials.

Questions are limited to 1,000 characters and conversations to eight turns. Nothing is saved by the application. Clear removes the conversation and posting. Native Back requires a new question to rebuild results.

No server, paid-model call or server rate/spend controls are active in this static demo. Any model-backed version would need separate server enforcement and an approved budget.
